title: Rivet workspace preset
description: npx create-nx-workspace --preset=@rivetjs/nx: an Nx workspace with the Rivet plugin and a first Rivet app.

name.description: Workspace name; also the default app name.

appName.description: Name of the first app (default: the workspace name).

directory.description: Folder of the first app (default apps/<appName>).

adapter.description: node: pages render per request; static: prerendered HTML. Default: from the template.

deploy.description: Platform target of the first app (create-rivet --deploy). bun and deno need --template=server.

tailwind.description: Tailwind v4. Default: on, except the minimal starter.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner of the first app.

skipInstall.description: Do not run the package manager install.
